title: Restriction of open extension by zero
statement:
For an open immersion $j$, the adjunction unit $M\to j^*j_!M$ is an
isomorphism on pro-etale module sheaves.

proof.text:
On an object $V$ over the open subscheme, every object in a covering of $V$
is still over that open subscheme. The presheaf defining $j_!M$ is therefore
exactly $M$ on this slice, and sheafification leaves it unchanged there.
Under the extension-by-zero adjunction, the resulting identification
$j^*j_!M=M$ sends the unit to the identity on every section. This proves the
statement for the named map.

lean.statement: theorem sfIntrinsicOpenUnit_isIso {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (M : proEtaleRingModules U (proEtaleConstantRing U A)) : IsIso ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZeroAdjunction j A).unit.app M)
lean.note: The previous upstream attachment states invertibility in a fixed coefficient category. This statement uses the currently recorded intrinsic extension-by-zero construction and its canonical transported adjunction, retaining the original mathematical statement and finite constant coefficient convention of def-weil-extension-by-zero.
